name: QiYi 3x3 Mirror Blocks (Luminous)
description: The QiYi 3x3 Mirror Blocks (Luminous) is a fun twist on the classic Mirror Cube, featuring glow-in-the-dark plastic for extra flair in low light. Instead of colors, this puzzle challenges you with shifting shapes, making every scramble visually striking. It's a great gift or novelty item for cubers who enjoy solving by shape. Charge it under a light and watch it glow!
